title: 第一卷 第13章 有得爽了第一卷 第14章 力量暴涨第一之争
content_zh:
山洞内，云梦儿深吸了一口气，擦去脸上的泪痕，披着秦逸的长袍走了出去。
下一刻，她神色一怔。
因为，山洞口的位置，放着一条长裙。
云梦儿回过神来，拿起长裙，重新回到了山洞内。
片刻后，她换上了长裙，却绷得太紧，有些难受。
但也好过于刚才那种情况了。
“明明已经知道我有多大了，还拿这么小的裙子……”云梦儿说道，脑海中，不由得又浮现了跟秦逸一起疯狂的画面。
…………
“你人还怪好的？”鼎爷调侃秦逸。
秦逸道：“毕竟是女人，总不能让她穿着我的长袍，里边却是破破烂烂。”
鼎爷：“那你就没想过，那个被你用剑威胁脱了裙子的女子？”
秦逸：“……我当时没想那么多。”
鼎爷：“也对，你当时就盯着那女子的身体看了，虽然远不如极品奶妈，但也还算不错。”
秦逸：“我没有看，我连她胸口那颗痣都没有看清楚！”
鼎爷：“呵呵！”
就在这时，秦逸察觉到，周围有好几道呼啸声响起。
好几个方向都有人，朝着他冲来。
因为他手里有一颗星辰石，星辰石的光芒冲天，极为明亮，所以，吸引了附近的人。
一颗星辰石，只要能拿住一个时辰，就能被灵珠吸收，成为一百星辰点。
考核已经过去了两天，七星秘境内的妖兽几乎被杀完了，想要获得更多的星辰点，就只能来抢夺这十颗星辰石。

“留下星辰石，我不为难你！”一个凝罡境十重修为的男子，手持长枪，枪尖直指秦逸。
“好！给你！”秦逸点头。
男子愣了一下，没想到秦逸放弃的如此果断。
可下一瞬，刺目的雷霆剑光，便在他的眼前炸开。
男子立刻往后暴退，手中长枪横挡在身前。
秦逸斩下的剑，劈在了长枪上。
强大的力量震荡，还有霸道的雷霆之力冲击，男子握住长枪的双手立刻就血肉模糊，他的身体往后倒射，然后撞在了一座山上。
身体完全陷入了山石内，大口吐血。
“明明可以直接碾压我，还跟我玩心眼？”男子内心郁闷。
而出现在周围的另外几个人，看到这一幕，全部停了下来。
秦逸的目光，从这几人身上扫过。
这几人头皮发麻，无形之中，好似有巨大的压力落在了他们身上。
“兄弟，我就是过来看看。”
“那是你的星辰石，我们没有想法。”
“没错，我只是好奇星辰石长什么样子。”
秦逸没有再理会这些人，继续飞遁。
他可不是逃跑，而是锁定了另外一束星辰石光芒的位置，他要去夺第二颗星辰石。
content_en:
In the cave, Yun Meng'er took a deep breath, wiped the tears on her face, and walked out wearing Qin Yi's robe.
The next moment, she looked stunned.
Because there was a long skirt placed at the entrance of the cave.
Yun Meng'er came back to her senses, picked up her long skirt, and returned to the cave.
After a while, she put on a long skirt, but it was too tight and uncomfortable.
But it's better than the situation just now.
"You obviously know how old I am, but you still wear such a small skirt..." Yun Meng'er said, and the scene of going crazy with Qin Yi appeared in her mind.
…………
"Are you a nice person?" Mr. Ding teased Qin Yi.
Qin Yidao: "She is a woman after all. She can't let her wear my robe with tatters inside."
Master Ding: "Then you haven't thought about the woman who took off her skirt when you threatened her with a sword?"
Qin Yi: "...I didn't think much about it at the time."
Master Ding: "That's right. You were staring at that woman's body. Although it's far inferior to the best nanny, it's still pretty good."
Qin Yi: "I didn't look. I didn't even see the mole on her chest clearly!"
Lord Ding: "Haha!"
At this moment, Qin Yi noticed that there were several whistling sounds around him.
There were people from several directions, rushing towards him.
Because he had a star stone in his hand, the light of the star stone reached the sky and was extremely bright, so it attracted people nearby.
As long as a star stone can be held for an hour, it can be absorbed by the spirit bead and become a hundred star points.
Two days have passed since the assessment, and almost all the monsters in the Seven Star Secret Territory have been killed. If you want to get more star points, you can only snatch these ten star stones.
"Leave the star stone, I won't embarrass you!" A man with a tenth level of Ning Gang realm was holding a spear, pointing directly at Qin Yi.
"Okay! Here you go!" Qin Yi nodded.
The man was stunned for a moment, but he didn't expect Qin Yi to give up so decisively.
But in the next moment, the dazzling thunderous sword light exploded in front of his eyes.
The man immediately stepped back, holding the spear in front of him.
Qin Yi's sword struck the spear.
The powerful shock and the impact of the domineering thunder force caused the man's hands holding the spear to become bloody and bloody. His body was shot backwards and then hit a mountain.
His body completely sank into the rocks and he vomited blood.
"You can obviously crush me directly, but you still play tricks on me?" The man felt depressed.
When the other people who appeared around saw this scene, they all stopped.
Qin Yi's eyes swept over these people.
These people's scalps were numb, and it seemed as if huge pressure was falling on them.
"Brother, I just came over to take a look."
"That's your star stone, we have no idea."
"Yes, I'm just curious about what the star stone looks like."
Qin Yi ignored these people and continued to fly away.
He is not running away, but has locked the position of another star stone light, and he is going to grab the second star stone.
